interpretation: lower values indicate a route to a training-presence anchor whose largest geographic edge is smaller relative to the scenario radius; this is a structural bottleneck diagnostic, not a dispersal probability or realized pathway
directional_hypothesis: within frozen pointwise-support quintile x nearest-anchor-distance quintile strata, the occupied member of a held-out presence-absence pair is expected to have a smaller median normalized geographic bottleneck than the absent member

conditioning.binning_and_pair_rule: identical to the frozen primary conditional concordance

aggregation: equal mean across estimable folds within species, then equal mean across estimable species
applicability: non-finite bottleneck values are not imputed; a species-fold is estimable only when finite bottleneck scores permit at least one held-out presence-absence comparison within the frozen 5x5 strata
claim_boundary: A positive result supports additional held-out information in a predeclared structural bottleneck diagnostic conditional on pointwise support and nearest-anchor distance; it does not identify dispersal probability, colonisation history, or a realized route.
